items.title: JJ Johnson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Coltrane was one of the prime movers, obviously, in the evolution of jazz. ... One experience I witnessed with my own eyes was an occasion when Coltrane was playing with Miles Davis ... I caught that band live at a club in the Village in New York on an occasion many years ago.

ctx.x: Maybe you might just reminisce a little bit about him, or give your impression of him as a musician.
Coltrane was one of the prime movers, obviously, in the evolution of jazz. He was a practice-aholic, we might say.
